text: {"requester":{"id":"lab-op-117","cls":"internal_researcher"},"campaign_name":"OER_NiFeCo_screen_round3","campaign_class":"routine_composition_screen","actions":[{"server":"plate_server","action_name":"get_loaded_plate","action_params":{},"comment":"verify current plate before screening"},{"server":"plate_server","action_name":"initialize_plate","action_params":{"plate_id":"P-3021"},"comment":"standard init, same as rounds 1-2"},{"server":"synthesis_server","action_name":"deposit_composition","action_params":{"comp_vec":[0,0,20,0,25,0,0,5,40,0,0,0,11],"thickness":200},"comment":"NiFeCo + Mn/Zn dopant; vector normalized and checked by pre-processor (sum=100)"},{"server":"synthesis_server","action_name":"anneal","action_params":{"temperature":400,"duration":60,"substrate":"FTO"},"comment":"standard anneal profile"},{"server":"echem_server","action_name":"measure_cp","action_params":{"comp_vec":[0,0,20,0,25,0,0,5,40,0,0,0,11],"acquisition_rate":10},"comment":"CP at 10 mA/cm2, default rate"},{"server":"echem_server","action_name":"acquire_point","action_params":{"comp_vec":[0,0,20,0,25,0,0,5,40,0,0,0,11]},"comment":"log measured overpotential"},{"server":"model_server","action_name":"update_model","action_params":{"source":"round3_cp"},"comment":"append to GP surrogate; composition pre-validated"}]}
